description:
Create an SEO Reporting report on a property — blank, or as a copy of an existing report/template (templateId, from list_reports) whose widgets and filters are copied. WRITE action — requires the write scope. Returns the new report id, name and widgets_count; then use add_report_widget to fill a blank one. The new report appears in the SEOcrawl Reporting UI exactly like one created by hand. Errors: reporting_not_available if the plan does not include SEO Reporting, report_limit_reached if the plan's report limit is hit, not_found for an unknown templateId, invalid_report_name for an empty or >255-character name. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// create a blank report to fill with widgets.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","name":"SEO filters board"}
```
name: create_report

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

title: Create report
